items.t: 3M (MMM) Looks Fairly Valued After Its PFAS Settlement Put A Key Risk In View
items.sum: 3M (MMM) just put a price tag and a timetable on a major legal overhang, agreeing to a US$7.35b PFAS personal injury settlement that defines cash outflows over nine years. Despite a 1-day share price return that declined 1.4% to US$186.24, 3M has logged a 30-day share price return of 14.42% and a year to date share price return of 15.09%. items.t: MMM Stock Climbed to an 8.5-Year High on a $7.35 Billion Forever Chemicals Settlement. The Overhang Could Finally Be Lifting.
items.sum: 3M climbed to an 8.5-year high after announcing a $7.35 billion settlement over nine years to resolve most firefighting-foam personal-injury claims.
